should_trigger.prompt: expert panel this blog post before I publish it
score my landing page copy — I want a real panel of critics, not just suggestions
rate these two email subject line variants and tell me which wins
run this through the panel and give me a quality score
quality check my sales page copy, I want it to hit 90 before we launch
panel-review this cold email before it goes to 500 prospects
two landing page variants attached — panel both and tell me which ships
before this goes out, tear it apart from every direction you can think of
should_trigger.note: situation phrasing: describes the circumstance without reusing the description's routing vocabulary — tests under-triggering, the axis lexical overlap hides
